title: GTFS-RT STAC Extension
description: STAC extension for cataloging GTFS-RT (General Transit Feed Specification - Realtime) data archives and snapshots.

gtfs-rt:agency_id.title: Agency ID
gtfs-rt:agency_id.description: Unique identifier for the transit agency.

gtfs-rt:agency_name.title: Agency Name
gtfs-rt:agency_name.description: Human-readable name of the transit agency.

gtfs-rt:feed_url.title: Feed URL
gtfs-rt:feed_url.description: URL of the live GTFS-RT feed.

gtfs-rt:static_feed_url.title: Static Feed URL
gtfs-rt:static_feed_url.description: URL of the associated static GTFS feed.

gtfs-rt:feed_types.title: Feed Types
gtfs-rt:feed_types.description: Types of GTFS-RT entities available in the feed.

gtfs-rt:gtfs_rt_version.title: GTFS-RT Version
gtfs-rt:gtfs_rt_version.description: Version of the GTFS-RT specification used by the feed (e.g., '2.0').

gtfs-rt:update_frequency_seconds.title: Update Frequency
gtfs-rt:update_frequency_seconds.description: Expected feed update interval in seconds.

gtfs-rt:feed_timestamp.title: Feed Timestamp
gtfs-rt:feed_timestamp.description: POSIX timestamp from the GTFS-RT FeedHeader indicating when the feed was created.

gtfs-rt:feed_version.title: Feed Version
gtfs-rt:feed_version.description: Matches feed_info.feed_version from the associated static GTFS feed.

gtfs-rt:incrementality.title: Incrementality
gtfs-rt:incrementality.description: Whether this feed snapshot is a full dataset or a differential update.

gtfs-rt:entity_count.title: Entity Count
gtfs-rt:entity_count.description: Total number of FeedEntity objects in the snapshot.

gtfs-rt:vehicle_count.title: Vehicle Count
gtfs-rt:vehicle_count.description: Number of VehiclePosition entities in the snapshot.

gtfs-rt:trip_update_count.title: Trip Update Count
gtfs-rt:trip_update_count.description: Number of TripUpdate entities in the snapshot.

gtfs-rt:alert_count.title: Alert Count
gtfs-rt:alert_count.description: Number of Alert entities in the snapshot.

gtfs-rt:vehicles_in_transit.title: Vehicles In Transit
gtfs-rt:vehicles_in_transit.description: Number of vehicles with status IN_TRANSIT_TO.

gtfs-rt:vehicles_stopped.title: Vehicles Stopped
gtfs-rt:vehicles_stopped.description: Number of vehicles with status STOPPED_AT.

gtfs-rt:avg_speed_mps.title: Average Speed
gtfs-rt:avg_speed_mps.description: Average vehicle speed in meters per second.

gtfs-rt:congestion_severe_count.title: Severe Congestion Count
gtfs-rt:congestion_severe_count.description: Number of vehicles reporting SEVERE_CONGESTION level.

gtfs-rt:alerts_by_cause.title: Alerts by Cause
gtfs-rt:alerts_by_cause.description: Count of alerts grouped by cause type.

gtfs-rt:alerts_by_effect.title: Alerts by Effect
gtfs-rt:alerts_by_effect.description: Count of alerts grouped by effect type.

gtfs-rt:alerts_severe_count.title: Severe Alert Count
gtfs-rt:alerts_severe_count.description: Number of alerts with SEVERE severity level.
